mapper.select: SELECT O.ONO, O.OPRICE, O.OPAYMENT, O.ODATE, O.OSTATUS, P.PNAME FROM ORDERS O LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER_PASSES MP ON O.ONO = MP.ONO LEFT OUTER JOIN PASS P ON MP.PNO = P.PNO WHERE O.MNO = #{mno} ORDER BY O.ONO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS(ONO, OPRICE, OPAYMENT, ODATE, MNO) VALUES(#{ono}, #{oprice}, #{opayment}, SYSDATE, #{mno})
